change.display_text: A rectangular coil rotates in a uniform magnetic field. State the orientation of the coil when the magnitude of the induced emf is greatest.
change.excerpt_note: Adapted from the source to assess this topic within the current syllabus.

answer.text: The plane of the coil is parallel to the field (its normal is perpendicular to the field). The flux is zero at that instant and its rate of change has maximum magnitude.

change.display_text: Electrons accelerated from rest through a potential difference have de Broglie wavelength 0.100 nm. The potential difference is quadrupled. Assuming non-relativistic motion, determine the new de Broglie wavelength.
change.excerpt_note: Adapted from the source to assess this topic within the current syllabus.

answer.text: The kinetic energy eV quadruples, so p = √(2meV) doubles. From λ = h/p, the wavelength halves to 0.0500 nm.

change.display_text: A battery has charge capacity 0.55 A h. A circuit draws one pulse of charge 9.4 μC from it each second. Estimate how many years the battery can supply these pulses. Assume its full charge capacity is usable.
change.excerpt_note: Adapted from the source to assess this topic within the current syllabus.

answer.text: The available charge is 0.55 × 3600 = 1980 C. Average current = 9.4 × 10⁻⁶ A. Time = 1980/(9.4 × 10⁻⁶) = 2.11 × 10⁸ s, approximately 6.7 years.
